title: Partner allocation
idea: Partner allocation: Partner balances and assigned batches lead an allocation review
audience: People who need to allocate inventory within a dashboard surface.
avoidWhen: Partner roles allow unrestricted customer access
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic ledger layout through its allocate inventory priority and explicit commitment contract: Allocation validates balance permissions and target ownership
navigation: Partner allocation keeps the current allocate inventory context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Partner balances and assigned batches lead an allocation review
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to allocate inventory; resellers receive bounded tag inventory
composition.priority: Allocation validates balance permissions and target ownership

imagery.role: Support the actual allocate inventory context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Present account and batch context above quantities
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the partner allocation structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no allocate inventory content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Allocation validates balance permissions and target ownership

stateContracts.success: Allocation validates balance permissions and target ownership
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active allocate inventory context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
